ledger.claim: The rider did exactly what POL-NS-04(a) asks: the chat log records two messages sent inside the waiting window that locate the rider and ask for the driver — "I am at Exit D under the green sign. Where is your car?" sent at 18:21:00 and "I still cannot see you. Please reply." sent at 18:23:25. Both name the pickup point, and the second states plainly that the rider cannot see the vehicle. Limb (a) is met on the face of the log.

The driver never answered, which is the whole of POL-NS-04(b). The 120-second window opened by the rider's 18:21:00 message closed at 18:23:00 with no driver message anywhere in the log — the only entry after it is the rider's own follow-up at 18:23:25 — and trip_record.in_app_calls is an empty array, so no in-app voice call was placed at any point before the 18:25:30 cancellation. The driver's own account that he "waited inside the station pickup geofence" describes a driver who was present and able to receive messages, which makes the silence unexplained rather than unavoidable.

The rider's own track satisfies POL-NS-04(c). For a TRANSPORT_HUB pickup the rider-presence radius is 200 m, and the rider track reports 16 fixes, every one of them qualifying (rider_qualifying_fix_count 16 of rider_fix_count 16), at a mean reported distance of 41.9 m, held across the waiting window from 18:20:30 to 18:25:30. On admissible fixes the rider was at the pickup point, not away from it, so limb (c) is affirmatively met and not merely undecidable.

With all three limbs of POL-NS-04 met, that clause exonerates the rider and refunds the cancellation fee in full, with no driver compensation payable. This is a rider win on the outcome: the SGD 6.00 cancellation_fee line was charged (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00) and must be returned. The displacement is express — POL-NS-01 makes its baseline charge stand only where "no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces them", and POL-NS-04 is precisely such a clause; the driver's technical arrival does not rescue a fee the rider-exonerating clause removes.

Nothing on this record escalates, so the fee should be refunded rather than held. POL-NS-09(c) needs two or more no-show disputes between this same rider and driver in the trailing 90 days and both counterparty counters are 0; POL-NS-09(d) and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check are not met either — no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against 120 completed_trips_30d, far below both the "4 or more" count and the 0.08 rate — and no_show_disputes_30d is 0. The case is decidable on the evidence before the tribunal.

The traffic advisory for this pickup, EV-ADVIS-09106-01, is MISSING — it carries no payload and therefore no fact — so no KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT is on file for this waiting window. No advisory is needed to extend the driver's hold and none could be asserted to excuse it: he was stationary the whole time, 24 m from the pin, and nothing external prevented him from typing a single reply to two messages from a rider standing at the same bay. The silence is a coordination failure under POL-NS-04, not a lawful impossibility.

The trip record carries both termination-side facts POL-NS-01 needs: a driver 'arrived' event at 2026-09-06T18:20:20+08:00, and a driver-side termination at 18:25:30 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, with no boarding event and no trip start recorded. Limb (a) and limb (d) are satisfied on the platform's own telemetry, not on the driver's say-so.

Limb (b) of POL-NS-01 and the proximity test in POL-NS-02 are satisfied many times over: all 34 driver fixes sit 24.01 m from the Tampines MRT Exit D private-hire bay pin, far inside the 150 m arrival radius that POL-NS-02 sets for a TRANSPORT_HUB zone class, and the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 18:20:00 precedes the 18:20:20 arrival marker, which is exactly what limb (b) requires.

Limb (c) is met with 30 seconds to spare. Measured as the clause requires - from the first qualifying in-geofence GPS fix and not from the arrived event - the driver held a single continuous in-geofence run from 18:20:00 to 18:25:30, 330 seconds across 34 fixes, against the 300 second minimum for TRANSPORT_HUB. The derived shortfall_sec is -30.0, a surplus, so the POL-NS-06 full-refund route for a premature cancellation has no purchase on these numbers.

The arrival marker is not a false marker under POL-NS-05. At the 18:20:20 marker the trace shows the driver stationary - distinct speed 0.0 kph - at 24.01 m from the pin, so neither trigger is remotely approached: not more than 300 m from the pin, and not travelling at 15 kph or above. Under POL-NS-05 limb (iii) a marker that is not false does not by itself defeat a fee where the dwell genuinely meets the minimum, and here it does.

POL-NS-03 is not engaged at all. That clause applies only where the driver is stationary outside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin; here the driver is 24.01 m from the pin, inside the 150 m radius rather than outside it. This is therefore not a wrong-entrance or wrong-block case, limb (b) of POL-NS-01 does not fail through that route, and no 50 percent pin-ambiguity goodwill figure is in play.

With POL-NS-01 satisfied in full and nothing in POL-NS-03, POL-NS-05 or POL-NS-06 displacing it, POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80 percent of the SGD 6.00 charge - SGD 4.80, which is the figure the fare breakdown's own derived block computes (driver_compensation 4.80 on a fee_charged of 6.00). The anti-farming check does not trip because it requires both limbs and neither is met: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, not 4 or more, and 1 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 120 is 0.0083, not above 0.08. Those two fields are the only ones POL-NS-07 reads.

Nothing that decides the driver's case is impaired on any limb of POL-NS-08. Clock skew between the 18:20:20 arrival marker and the nearest fix at 18:20:00 is 20 seconds, inside the 90 second limit. The trace carries 34 fixes with no gap and max_gap_sec of 0.0 across a 330 second wait, far above the 6-fix floor. The chat log's 3 messages match trip_record.chat_message_count of 3, with an unbroken msg_id sequence and no 5 minute gap. And the SGD 6.00 cancellation fee equals the fee_schedule resolution rule's GREATER of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone fee (6.00) and the RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee (6.00), so no fare defect arises either.

No POL-NS-09 trigger fires, so this case is decidable by a monetary ruling rather than a human reviewer: disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0 on both sides, so there are not 2 or more no-show disputes between this pair; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, not 3 or more; the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check is clear; and no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence. The lifetime prior_no_show_flags counters (2 on the driver, 1 on the rider) are near-synonyms that are context only under POL-GEN-01 and may not be substituted for the trailing-window figures these tests read.

ledger.claim: No traffic advisory covers this pickup road and the driver does not pretend otherwise: EV-ADVIS-09106-01 is MISSING, has no payload and carries weight 0.0, so the POL-NS-06(i) accumulation of separate in-geofence intervals is available to neither side. The driver does not need it - his 330 seconds is a single continuous in-geofence run, run_count 1, not a sum of intervals - and the absence of an advisory is citable as exactly the absence it is.

The driver's exposure on this record is POL-NS-04 and he does not dispute it: both rider messages fall inside the waiting window (18:21:00 and 18:23:25, each read by the driver at 18:21:15 and 18:23:40), the driver posted no chat reply within 120 seconds of either and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, and the rider's device lies within the 200 m TRANSPORT_HUB presence radius on all 16 of its qualifying fixes. If the judge applies POL-NS-04 it displaces the POL-NS-01 fee and forecloses POL-NS-07 compensation; what the driver submits is that the arrival and dwell findings above stand verified either way, on weight-1.0 artifacts, and should be recorded as found.

On the driver's case the disposition is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, not NO_ACTION. The fee stands exactly as charged - payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00 - and because POL-NS-07 compensation is paid, POL-GEN-03 puts the SGD 4.80 figure into amount_sgd as well as driver_compensation_sgd: it is the amount the ruling moves, not a refund to the filing party, and the two figures are not to be double-counted as a rider payout.

ruling.explanation:
Both parties should read this. The disputed SGD 6.00 cancellation fee is refunded in full to the rider.

The facts are largely agreed and the platform's own records settle them. The driver did reach the pickup: the trip record shows an 'arrived' event at 18:20:20 and a driver-side termination at 18:25:30 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, and the GPS trace places all 34 of his fixes 24.01 m from the Tampines MRT Exit D private-hire bay — well inside the 150 m arrival radius for a TRANSPORT_HUB. Measured as POL-NS-01(c) requires, from the first in-geofence fix at 18:20:00 and not from the arrival tap, he held position for 330 seconds, 30 seconds over the 300-second minimum, with no gap and a max_gap_sec of 0.0. So the driver's account that he waited inside the geofence is corroborated, and there is no false-arrival marker under POL-NS-05.

That does not decide the case. POL-NS-04 exonerates the rider where three things hold together, and all three do. (a) The rider sent two locating messages inside the waiting window: 'I am at Exit D under the green sign. Where is your car?' at 18:21:00 and 'I still cannot see you. Please reply.' at 18:23:25. (b) The driver never answered: the 120-second window opened by the 18:21:00 message closed at 18:23:00 with no reply, trip_record.in_app_calls is empty, and no in-app voice call was made at any point before the 18:25:30 cancellation. (c) The rider's device was at the pickup: all 16 of its fixes qualify, spanning 18:20:30 to 18:25:30, at a mean reported distance of 41.9 m, inside the 200 m presence radius for a TRANSPORT_HUB. The rider was where they were supposed to be and was actively trying to coordinate; the silence was the driver's.

POL-NS-04 is one of the clauses POL-NS-01 itself names as displacing its baseline charge. Because it applies, the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full, and the clause states no driver compensation is payable. The driver's POL-NS-07 claim to 80 percent (SGD 4.80) therefore fails — not because the arrival and dwell findings are wrong, which they are not, but because POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it. The driver's own submission correctly identified POL-NS-04 as the exposure. The POL-NS-03 wrong-entrance route does not apply either: 24.01 m is inside the arrival radius, not the 400 m band outside it, so no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises.

I have checked the escalation triggers and none fires. rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0; both disputes_with_counterparty_90d counters are 0, so POL-NS-09(c) is not met; and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming test does not trip — 1 no-show termination against 120 completed trips, below both the '4 or more' count and the 0.08 rate. The lifetime prior_no_show_flags counters (2 on the driver, 1 on the rider) are context only under POL-GEN-01 and carry nothing here. No two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence.

The SGD 6.00 refunded is the cancellation_fee line on the fare breakdown (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00), which reconciles with the fee schedule: the GREATER of the TRANSPORT_HUB zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_PLUS vehicle-tier fee (SGD 6.00). No artifact is impaired on any limb of POL-NS-08 — 20 seconds of clock skew against the 90-second limit, no sampling gap and 34 fixes against the 6-fix floor, 3 chat messages matching trip_record.chat_message_count of 3 with an unbroken msg_id sequence, and a cancellation line equal to the schedule figure — so the finding rests on full-weight evidence. The missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-09106-01, weight 0.0) is relied on by neither side and has no bearing; the driver needed no accumulated-dwell extension, as his 330 seconds is a single continuous run.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
